summary: Still-staffed 1953 L-4 lookout on the Nez Perce/Bitterroot forest boundary, NHLR-listed 2009 and NRHP-listed 2018.

facts.design: 1936-pattern L-4 cab with catwalk on a 10-foot wooden tower

access.note: active, staffed fire lookout reached by hiking in through the Selway-Bitterroot Wilderness; not set up as a public rental

visit.trail_note: hike-in only; within a designated wilderness area, no mechanized access

events.note: original L-3 cupola cabin on a 5-foot log crib
present 1936-pattern L-4 cab on 10-foot wooden tower built, replacing the 1925 structure
added to National Historic Lookout Register, US 787, April 24, 2009
listed on National Register of Historic Places, reference 100002295, April 6, 2018

evidence.supports: 1953 L-4 cab replacing 1925 L-3 cabin; location; regularly staffed
evidence.quote: The standard 1936-model hip-roof L-4 cab lookout with catwalk on a 10' wooden tower at Gardiner Peak Lookout on the Nez Perce National Forest was built in 1953. It replaced an L-3 cupola cabin on a 5' log crib constructed in 1925.

evidence.supports: location on wilderness boundary; staffing status
evidence.quote: Gardiner Peak sits above the Selway River within the Selway-Bitterroot Wilderness Area on the boundary between the Nez Perce National Forest and the Bitterroot National Forest. Gardiner is regularly staffed for fire detection.

evidence.supports: 1953 built date, NRHP listing 2018, elevation, L-4 pattern
evidence.quote: The Gardiner Peak Lookout, on Gardiner Peak in the West Fork District of Bitterroot National Forest, near Darby, Idaho, was built in 1953. It was listed on the National Register of Historic Places in 2018.

evidence.supports: hike-in access, staffed status, named staff including Al Koenigs (1925, 1927), Tommy Reed (1956), Lawrence Gilley (2010)
evidence.quote: Hike-In AbaStaffed ... 1925 Al Koenigs Charlie Hamphill ... 1927 Al Koenigs (Fire Lookout Museum) ... 1956 Tommy Reed ( Forest Fire Lookout Page ) ... 2010 Lawrence Gilley

corrections.why: Sources describe it as a regularly staffed, hike-in-only lookout within a wilderness area, not open as a public rental or drive-up site.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR page gives the NHLR registration date (April 24, 2009); the separate NRHP federal listing came later, April 6, 2018, per Wikipedia. These are two different registers, not a conflict, but easy to confuse.

notes_for_editor: Brief's elevation (2010.8 m / 6597 ft) matches both NHLR and Wikipedia exactly. Brief's access field was 'unknown'; proposed 'restricted' based on hike-in, staffed, wilderness-area status. Idahofirelookouts staff list had some garbled text (e.g. 'AbaStaffed') from page formatting; used only the clean names/years. Al Koenigs is recorded in 1925 and 1927 (not 'late 1920s'); Tommy Reed is recorded only in 1956, not 'much of the 1950s' -- story corrected to match the source's actual staff-year entries.
